name: create-small-wpf-utility
prompt: Create a small .NET 10 WPF desktop utility with a single window, settings persistence, and one unit-test project. Avoid unnecessary modular architecture.
rubric: Chooses the compact architecture tier and explains why it is sufficient.
Targets net10.0-windows with UseWPF and includes a testable non-UI boundary.
Does not introduce runtime plugins, an event bus, or excessive projects without evidence.
